changelog: Require a title or topic so the thumbnail can be read with the title, and keep candidate directions structurally different.

en.description: Create YouTube thumbnails from a video topic, title, script, key frame, portrait, product photo, or channel reference. This AI thumbnail maker compares three directions in text first, then renders the one you pick as a 16:9 image with clear visual hooks, readable hierarchy, and a headline-safe composition for explainers, reviews, tutorials, vlogs, games, podcasts, and long-form creative videos. It pairs the image with title-matching advice and refines an accepted direction into a consistent channel look. Rendering requires a Beatra account at beatra.ai.
en.summary: Turn a YouTube topic, title, script, key frame, portrait, product photo, or channel reference into three thumbnail directions described in text, then render the one you pick as a 16:9 image with the headline area kept clear. Leave with a title that matches the image and a channel rule the next video can reuse.
en.title: YouTube Thumbnail Maker: Long-Form Video Covers
